notes.title: 1.03 Bug Fix
notes.notes:
- Fixed an issue where the game would freeze occasionally due to debris.
- Added a 50ms delay between certain sound effects (e.g., laser) to prevent loud sound.

notes.title: 1.01 Bug fixes
notes.notes:
- Data Leacher now works properly when clicking quickly
- Space background image at the end of the map has been extended
- Background in some main menu popups now appears dark
- When clicking quickly, multiple debris will no longer be created at the same location
- Added a black border to the map icons
- After an event that causes a battle, the music will start
- Different music for each map

notes.title: V0.21 Content Update
notes.notes:
The second zone is available for testing for a short period of time.

- Changed some sound (hopefully smoother to the ears)
- Added more sound effect
- Added animation on the main menu
- Started the 2nd zone
- Added an indicator that it's possible to move the map in the overworld
- Added new items
- Fixed a bunch of bugs
- Updated some items

The next update should focus on the random events.
